description.en:
Dual Sword Phantom Slayer is a Transcendent grade melee weapon in the Transcendence Series.

## Overview

* This weapon can be obtained from the Transcendence Decoder.

These dual swords were infused with the absolute power of both the gatekeepers of the heaven and the gatekeeper of the underworld in order to destroy the evil that blights the world with corruption.

Meet a special trigger condition to unleash a feast

### Advantages

* High stun power (A mode)
 * Very high damage in all modes
 * Can kill multiple enemies at once
 * Secondary fire has the highest ROF of all melee weapons
 * Far attack range in special mode
 * Lighter than regular melee

### Disadvantages

* Obtainable only during the event period
 * No knockback power
 * Still can be outclassed with Blade Runebreaker's charged mode

## Release date

* South Korea: 21 September 2017.
 * Taiwan/Hong Kong: 26 September 2017.
 * China &  Japan : 27 September 2017.
 * Indonesia: 6 December 2017.
 * CSN:Z: 9 May 2018.

## Tips

* Overall
 * To activate the "special attack", the wielder must combine its attack in the right order which is >>>> click.
 * The maximum range of the special mode can reach is 5 meters
 * Since this weapon doesn't have or has very little knockback power, be careful while using it.
 * The blue sword (A mode) does 2 stab which have great stun power and deals very high damage on the second stab. The yellow sword (B mode) does 4 slashes in a quick succession but has low stun power, the last slash deals the higher damage.
 * This weapon is overpowered in a match of Knife Battle Team Deathmatch or Original, can easily kill opponents without much effort, especially when using the special attack.

 * Zombie Hero
 * The special mode last for 10 seconds, a great opportunity to kill zombies while it's active. Combine it with Deadly Shot for a devastating output.
 * Never face a Heavy zombie alone while using the swords, considering it has a really decent stun reduction as his passive skill.
 * Use A mode when facing a horde of zombies, as it has high stun power, long attack range and can hit multiple zombies at once.
 * There is a slight delay after using both modes.
 * Even in special mode, there are delays too. It is when activating the Sword Feast and after the Sword Feast ends.
 * To eliminate these delays, emote cancelling (J+3, hold left or right click) can be used, or quickswitching (Q twice). Whichever is faster depends on the user.

 * Zombie Scenario
 * Use its special mode to clear out hordes of zombies.
 * This weapon is a great barrier-breaker. It deals great amount of damage using any of its three modes.
 * There is a bug where the user can spam its attacks rapidly, by holding the respective mouse button and pressing F2 rapidly in buy zones. This bug also happens with Warhammer Storm Giant.
 * This weapon has the greatest DPS against bosses out of any currently-released weapon. The second stab of A mode is capable of reaching upwards of 600,000 damage, with a critical hit to a boss's weak point. Oberon's Horns are recommended. Using the above F2 trick, its DPS nearly doubles.

## Users

Counter-terrorist:
 * May : Seen in posters.

## Variant

These are two demon swords that the two guardians of heaven and earth have infused with their absolute power to destroy the evil that is causing chaos in the world. When the special attack activation conditions are met, a feast of swords unfolds. Obtainable from Magma Weapon Selection Box.
 * Dual Sword Magma
 * Special skill activation conditions: Enter    without interruption. Continuous attack in 360 degrees for a certain period of time.

## Trivia

* This is the first akimbo melee weapon in the Transcendence Series despite being pseudo in game.
 * When either sword impacts any wall or enemy, rose petals and cherry blossoms emerge. This does not occur for the sword feast.
 * This is the first weapon to have a combo attack.
 * The idle sound of A mode similar to AUG Guardian.
 * This is the first transcendence weapon that has a minor variant.

Dual Uzi Blank is a Unique grade submachine gun under the Blank Weapon Series in Counter-Strike Online.

## Overview

These are two UZIs utilizing an extended magazine holding 80 rounds of 9mm ammunition. They are designed to release silver particles upon firing, inflicting significant damage on zombies. A more accurate strike is possible when shouldered. While some features have been weakened compared to the original, the damage has been increased. Further upgrades can be used to deliver even more powerful firepower.
 * This weapon can undergo Weapon Enhancement and compatible with Part System.
 * This weapon and the original Dual UZI will be added to the New Classic (Zombie) weapon restriction list.
 * This weapon does not change its appearance at +6 and +8 upgrades.
 * This weapon is compatible with translucent paint schemes.

## Release date

* South Korea: 2 April 2026.

* Damage (Chest): +4 (44, 45, 46, 47, 48)
 * Damage (Head) : +4 (178, 182, 186, 190, 194)
 * Accuracy: +5
 * Recoil: +3
 * Speed: +2 (240, 245, 250)
 * Rate of fire: +1
 * Ammo: +5 (80, 84, 88, 92, 96, 100)

 * Analysis
 * Unenhanced Dual Uzi Blank can deal around 3,520-14,240 damage in a full mag.
 * Fully enhanced damage and ammo Dual Uzi Blank can deal around 4,800-19,400 damage in a full mag.
 * Compared to Dual Uzi +6 that deals 7,040-28,160 damage in a full mag, Dual Uzi Blank is still left behind without the Parts support. However, with damage parts, it can deal more damage than Dual Uzi +6.

* Positive

 * Can be attached with parts

 * Neutral
 * Same rate of fire
 * Same knockback

 * Negative
 * Lower accuracy
 * Higher recoil
 * Heavier
 * Lower stun

Dual Uzi is a submachine gun in Counter-Strike Online.

## Overview

This is the akimbo version of Uzi chambered with 80 rounds of 9mm. It is coated with a special design to deal more damage to zombies. Its B mode unfolds the stocks, narrowing the projectile spread.

### Advantages

* Cheap ammo cost
 * High rate of fire
 * High accuracy, especially in B mode
 * No speed reduction
 * Low recoil
 * High magazine size
 * High damage for an SMG
 * Possesses high stun power
 * Can be enhanced

### Disadvantages

* Expensive price
 * Easily run dry
 * Hard to obtain

 * Taiwan/Hong Kong: 22 September 2015.
 * China: 23 September 2015.
 *  Japan: 30 September 2015.
 *  Indonesia: 3 February 2016.

## Tips

* Overall

 * If a a player drops or switches to a different weapon the Dual Uzi, its buttstocks will remain unfolded, which means that it cannot stay folded upon meeting with these circumstances.
 * In B mode, its bullet spread is very low. Use this as an advantage to deal headshot more easily. But it has a drawback that will decrease its fire rate, so don't use B mode in enclosed areas or in hasty situations.
 * 80 rounds of Dual Uzi can deal 2000 ~ 8000 damage to zombies in Zombie Infection modes, depending on where it hits, the usage of Deadly Shot and the level of Morale Boost.
 * Enhance it to +6 to improve it's perfomance

## Variant

 * Main article: Brick Piece S1451.

This is a modified version of Dual Uzi with 80 rounds of plastic bullets. It can be recombined to be a mini rocket launcher to fire 3 grenades at a time to deal massive damage.

A more accurate strike is possible when shouldered. While some features have been weakened compared to the original, the damage has been increased. Further upgrades can be used to deliver even more powerful firepower.

## Comparisons

Uzi=

 * Positive
 * Higher damage to Humans (+3), Zombies (+10) and Scenario (+47)
 * Higher accuracy (+15%)

 * Higher knockback power (+4%)

Dual Kriss=

Dual Wakizashi (デュアル わきざし, Duaru Wakizashi ) is a dual-wielded variant of the Wakizashi in Counter-Strike Online.

## Overview

Dual-wielded Wakizashi has the fastest slash among most of the melee weapons. Dual Wakizashi can perform a double critical damage to the target with its slash delay by raising both hands and slashing in an X pattern.

Dual Wakizashi can be obtained from the Wakizashi Upgrade Event by collecting 500 kill points with permanent single Wakizashi.

### Advantages

* High damage in both modes
 * Able to do double attack in primary mode
 * Long attack range
 * Able to damage multiple enemies
 * Available in most modes

### Disadvantages

* Can only be obtained through the Wakizashi upgrade event
 * Has attack delay in secondary mode
 * Low slash rate

## Release date

* South Korea: 13 September 2012.
 * Taiwan/Hong Kong: 9 October 2012.
 * China: 10 October 2012.
 * Japan: 26 September 2012.
 * Singapore/Malaysia: 13 August 2013.
 * Indonesia: 6 November 2013.
 * Turkey: 24 September 2014.
 * Vietnam: 16 July 2015.
 * CSN:Z: 27 January 2016.

### Overall

* Aiming for the head and controlling your distances between you and your enemies are the keys to master the Dual Wakizashi.
 * Dual Wakizashi's primary slash's range is shorter and weaker than secondary slash, but is able to damage multiple enemies (up to 3 enemies).
 * Recommended for Knife Battle and Zombie Scenario.

### Knife battle

* When chased by the enemy, run backward and use primary attack.
 * Use secondary slash more often when engaged in close quarters with enemies.
 * Attack on head or back for instant kill. One slash in the head is enough to kill an enemy.

### Zombie Scenario

* Dual Wakizashi's primary slash can kill multiple enemies. Plus it destroys barriers easily.
 * Do not confront mini-bosses especially with primary mode.

### Zombie Mods

* Experienced players can use this in Zombie Mods.
 * Primary slash for surprise attack and secondary slash to confront zombies face-to-face.
 * Aim for the head or back to deal tremendous damage.
 * Equip with high-stun weapons such as XM1014 and Dual Infinity.

### Positive

* Higher damage output in both modes
 * Damages multiple enemies with primary slash
 * Higher slash range in secondary slash

### Neutral

* Purchasable by both teams

### Negative

* Can only attack a single enemy in secondary slash
 * Shorter slash range in primary slash
 * Lower rate of fire

## Variant

* Dual Katana Anubis

Quickly cuts down everything in your path with two sharp katanas. The special attack, a two-handed raised slash, inflicts fatal damage to a single target.

## Trivia

* This the third dual-wielded melee weapon introduced in Counter-Strike Online. The first one is Dragon Claw, the second is Dual Nata Knife and the fourth is BALROG-IX.
 * This is one of the melee weapons that can kill an unarmored player with just one slash.
 * There is an orange wave effect after every slash.
 * For primary attack, the damage for every ninth slash is doubled, regardless of interruption.

summary.en: Duration Extender is an item in Counter-Strike Online.

description.en:
Duration Extender is an item in Counter-Strike Online.

## Overview

The duration extender increases the duration of the weapons you owned, with some exceptions: certain Code Box weapons, Red firearms, Camouflage edition weapons and event-exclusive weapons depending on the region. One unit allows the extension of the deadline by one day. The amounts can be stacked, allowing time-restricted weapons to be granted permanent statuses upon achieving 1000 days duration in total.

It is obtainable from Code Box with a moderately high chance, as well as being obtainable by disassembling weapons in the Craft menu. Disassembling a permanent weapon will guarantee a total of 100 Duration Extenders.

With the removal of Craft and Mileage Decoder, Duration Extenders replace weapon recipes and duration materials, hence they can be found in Loot Box drops, Battlefield Supply rewards, Daily Mission and Weekly Mission rewards in varying quantities.

## Trivia

* Not all regions allow extension on some weapons. For example, you can extend the duration of an Eruptor in CSO Korea, but you cannot do the same in Nexon Zombies. This is due the fact that some weapons are only obtainable from decoders which is locked from being extended.
 * This item cannot extend the duration of characters or other items.
 * It is the only prevalent item in the Mileage Decoders.

Eclipse Shifter is an Epic grade pistol in Counter-Strike Online.

## Overview

A secondary weapon that condenses light energy to serve as its power source. It continuously absorbs light energy to generate projectiles and emits waves of light to attack nearby enemies while in use. Light energy can be used to leap into stealth mode or to summon a guardian spirit that follows the player to attack and push back enemies. Using light energy triggers Resonance, which restores projectiles and reduces the light energy cost of the next special ability used within a certain time.

### Advantages

* Has stealth ability in Eclipse Phase
 * Ammo is unlimited - Lacks reliability on Supply Boxes
 * Eclipse Phase and Luminary Call can restores primary ammo
 * Eclipse Phase and Luminary Call can be used up to 3 times
 * Eclipse Phase and Luminary Call grants total invincibility (also immune to explosion and excessive damage)
 * Luminary Call deals high knockback to zombies
 * Eclipse Resonance can automatically attack enemies by just holding the weapon
 * Eclipse Phase removes movement impeding effects
 * Eclipse Phase leaves a Luminari area that stays on last known location to prevent the player from being traced
 * Decent firing speed
 * Light weight
 * Fast draw ability

### Disadvantages

* Lower damage compared to other Epic pistols
 * Short stealth time (3 seconds)
 * Expensive for a pistol
 * Eclipse Resonance has moderate attack speed and damage
 * Ineffective if used for killing purpose
 * Take time to recharge energy even for single use
 * Luminari Call does not remove movement impeding effect

## Special Ability

* Effects per ability may vary depending on the mode.

Uses light energy to transform the user into a photon state, allowing them to leap in the direction they are facing and grant temporary invincibility and stealth effects. One Luminari is summoned at the location where it was used and attacks nearby enemies for a certain period of time.
 * <Eclipse Phase>

Uses light energy to summon three Guardian Luminari that follow the user for a certain period of time, granting temporary invincibility and a movement speed increase buff. The Guardian Luminari move following the user, periodically dealing damage to nearby enemies and pushing back zombies. It persists even if the weapon is switched, but the maximum summon duration is reduced.
 * <Call Luminari>

Activates automatically when using Eclipse Phase or Call Luminari. Light resonance occurs, restoring ammo and reducing the light energy cost of the next special ability used within a certain period. If the special ability is used again within the time limit, the duration is refreshed.
 * <Eclipse Resonance>

## Buffs

* Notification appears on crosshair upon successful hit
 * Unlimited spare magazine in Scenario Mode

## Release date

* South Korea: 9 July 2026.

## Eclipse Shifter LE

* Only players who possess 2 or more Eclipse Shifters are eligible to participate in the synthesis event.
 * When synthesizing, one spare Eclipse Shifter is consumed to obtain Eclipse Shifter LE.
 * Eclipse Shifter LE has no performance difference from the existing Eclipse Shifter.
 * Eclipse Shifters currently in use and limited-time weapons cannot be used as synthesis materials.

## Updates

* 23 July 2026
 * Slightly increased duration of <Eclipse Resonance>
 * Increased damage of the passive that attacks nearby enemies while using the weapon (Zombie/Zombie Scenario)
 * Increased damage of <Call Luminari> (Zombie/Zombie Scenario)

## Trivia

* This is the fourth weapon with Holy Light concept after the Divine Blaster, Sandalphon and Brionac.
 * This weapon combines the features of Giga Break, Thunder Ghost Walker, Pulse Reactor and Sylphid. It is likely meant to be a weapon that has synergy with the Giga Break.
 * This is also the first secondary Epic weapon that has no reserve ammunition as both primary and secondary cartridge recharges itself for unlimited usage.

Electron-III is a Unique grade submachine gun under the Electron Series in Counter-Strike Online.

## Overview

A submachine gun that fires 80 energy bullets. As a special function, it can fire special bullets that are automatically charged when fired, and can be used immediately around you or fired at a target.
 * Electron Storm: Consumes special bullets and fires an electron storm on the surroundings. Special bullets are automatically charged when fired.
 * Electron Shot: Hold right click then release to consumes special bullets and fires an electron storm on the surroundings as well as its electrical explosives forward. Special bullets are automatically charged when fired.

## Release Date

* China: 20 December 2023.
 * Korea: 11 July 2024.
 * CSNS: 24 July 2024
 * Taiwan/Hong Kong: 24 July 2024

## Trivia

* This is the first Unique grade weapon to have a SS rating (Zombie Mode), which can surpass most of Transcendent grade weapons.
 * The Electron Storm effect is akin to Spell Lance Scarlet Rose Overload function, with an exception that it cannot take effect through walls and objects.
 * Enemies hit by Electron Storm will be forced dropping to the ground and not be able to jump. The slow effect reduces movement units as well as applying high gravity on hit targets.
 * This weapon ejects pistol casings when fired.

description.en:
Electron Series is a series of Brand Weapons released in Counter-Strike Online.

## Overview

Just like the CROW Series, TURBULENT Series and CHARGER Series, this weapon brand does not have a clear identity of its manufacturer but its stated to have its own exclusive technology that ultilize electricity to combat powerful zombies

## Electron-V

A two-burst assault rifle that fires 50 energy bullets. As a special function, it can fire special bullets that are automatically charged when fired, and can be used immediately around you or fired at a target.

## Electron-III

A submachine gun that fires 80 energy bullets. As a special function, it can fire special bullets that are automatically charged when fired, and can be used immediately around you or fired at a target.

## Electron-XI

A shotgun that fires 40 energy pellets. As a special function, it can fire special bullets that are automatically charged when fired, fires an special attack that cause area wide electric damage as well as moving itself to nearby enemy in range.

## Electron-VII

A machine gun that uses 120 energy bullets. It can fire special bullets to create a lightning zone in a wide area in front of it. When charged and fired, additional lightning strikes occur along the firing path.

## Trivia

* The numbering system of this series is similar to the BALROG Series, which uses Latin numeral.
 * The Electron series is introduced as an anniversary items in China region (Comrade Day) before those were released to other regions months later.
 * Electron-III is the only weapon in the series to have SS rating (Zombie Mode) despite not being a transcendent weapon.
 * It is possible to mention that this series inherits the discontinued CHARGER Series.
 * A new weapon is released annually, making it the longest series to be completed.

 * Lighter (-5% weight)

 * Longer reload time (+1.0 second)

Elemental Tracker is a Unique grade assault rifle in Counter-Strike Online.

## Overview

This rifle is enchanted with elemental magic. While looking through the sniper scope, you can lock onto an enemy, then fire 10 guided elemental missiles when you leave sniper mode.
 * Details: Press twice while holding down  to change elements. Available Elements: Wind (kockback), Fire (afterburn), Lightning (stun).

 * Very low recoil
 * High rate of fire
 * Extremely light

### Disadvantages

description.en:
Epic Edition weapons or formerly known as the Flex Weapons are the limited weapons that are available in the final stage of Epic Fragment event. They can only be obtained once per account and cannot be traded.

2026=

 * Death Cue

A composite energy machine gun newly developed by the Aegis Research Lab to enhance the firepower and survivability of allies. It can fire Rescue grenades, which can heal allies' wounds, and Deathcue grenades, which can suppress the front lines with overwhelming firepower.

 * Impulse Flail

A unique mace that extends its chain when attacked. It specializes in subduing multiple enemies by striking across a wide area. Depending on the battlefield, it can be used to trigger a finishing blow following a spinning attack, or it can trigger repeated explosions to knock back enemies over a wide area.

2025=
 * -|

 * USAS-12 Thunderfall

A weapon based on the Daewoo USAS-12 developed by the Aegis Institute, using 40 12-gauge shotgun rounds. When hitting an enemy a certain number of times with a basic attack, lightning strikes. When the special bullet collides with an enemy or wall, it explodes and strikes a certain number of targets within the blast radius.

 * Firefox

A submachine gun imbued with the spirit of a fire fox that charms enemies. In zombie mode, it activates the assist function for enemies within a certain distance. In zombie mode and zombie scenario mode, it automatically burns nearby enemies.

2024=
 * -|

 * OICW Hellfire

An OICW that appears to looks as if it was smelted in a smithy of hell. Destroys the battlefield with endless series of explosions targeting zombies.

 * M134 Minigun Umbra

This powerful minigun is chambered for 300 rounds of 7.62mm and is possessed by the specter of a prolific special force member from the past. The specter appears in the form of a shadow soldier as you defeat enemies, firing with a pinpoint precision before vanishing.

2023=
 * -|

 * M3 Azhi Dahaka

A shotgun imbued with the soul of a demonic dragon. Its basic attack is accompanied by dragon breath, which can be used to unleash a <Dragon Burst> on a marked target, and <Dragon Rising>, which summons the dragon to fight alongside you.

 * Hécate II Umbra

This powerful bolt action sniper rifle is chambered for 20 rounds of .50 BMG and is possessed by the specter of a prolific special force member from the past. The specter appears in the form of a shadow soldier as you defeat enemies, firing with a pinpoint precision before vanishing.

2022=
 * -|

 * Gigantic Drill

A customizable weapon for the Magnum Drill. It pours out 50 4-gauge shotgun bullets or pierces and crushes the enemy using the 2nd mode giant drill. Equipped as a main weapon, the knockback effect is in Zombie and Scenario modes only.

 * Psychic Sizer

This is a customized weapon of Psychic Harmonium, a sonic weapon produced by Gunsmith. It can use sonic shot attack using sonic energy and sonic pulse, which is an all-round attack, and combines special commands. By doing so, new and powerful potentials can be used.

2021=
 * -|

 * Astra

A weapon specialized for hunting zombies produced by the Aegis Lab. After the projectile flies through a certain distance, it returns to the user again. At this time, if the Astra is still out when it returned, the projectile is recovered; otherwise, it will be destroyed. Projectiles can be fired one more time before being retrieved. Scoring a headshot deals prolonged damage and also strikes nearby enemies.

 * Thunder Force

A weapon made of a lightweight alloy created by a private sector directed-energy lab that researches lasers. Equipped with a feature that automatically attacks enemies with infinite energy bolts.

2020=
 * -|

 * Inferno Cannon

A shotgun that rapidly fires 45 rounds of 12 gauge shotgun ammo. Its special feature, Infernal Flame, allows it to shoot fireballs.

 * Scorching Auto-Shotgun

A customized version of the Hunter-Killer shotgun, a 30-round 12 Gauge shotgun developed by Kronos. The Hunter-Killer Module allows you to use Tactical Scanning in full auto mode, marking zombies after landing enough hits on them.

summary.en: The Epic Weapons is a weapon grade in Counter-Strike Online. Those are the peak of extraordinary weapons that said to posses horrifying power and ability

description.en:
The Epic Weapons is a weapon grade in Counter-Strike Online. Those are the peak of extraordinary weapons that said to posses horrifying power and ability

## Overview

During the time of chaos all over the world. And increasing number of super powers as well of the enhancement of evil forces, the Epic Weapons, said to came from many world and universe, that goes way beyond what humanity can imagine. The Epic Weapons said to contain a horrifying power that can decimate everything into oblivion. Its abilities are well known from what human minds think it possibly can be... from fairy tales to future storytelling. There are really few source of creation for those extremely dangerous weapons... but all of them are beyond the league of common humans. To those who created them, its a really critical item that could lead into a risk of global destruction if it falls into the wrong hands.

But as the time passes, it slowly reaching to the hands of humanity in increasing number, if those weapons are used on the right purpose, humanity might have a chance to be saved in peace once again... with possibility from least to zero number of sacrifice. A tool to turn the tide of the future where all the people are at the birk of extinction... Many expert scientist are trying to learn more about those weapons and their automated abilities by cooperating with those who are creating them, and humanity will look for more weapons of such, as the battle for their survival its still having a long way to go.

## Obtaining Procedures

Unlike other weapons, until now, the weapons from this series are only obtainable in the Epic Decoder and/or from completing the Epic Fragment, Divine Fragment or Dark Shard events.

For new Epic Weapons releases, the only ways to obtain are:

 * Epic Decoder
 * Old Epic Fragment events (For Gungnir, Dread Nova, Heaven Splitter and Void Avenger)
 * Letter Collecting Event (Only for Epic weapons relealsed in New Lunar Year, starting from Divine Blaster)
 * New epic fragment events and their respective shops:
 * Holy Fragment (For Divine Blaster)
 * Haunted Fragment (For Twin Shadow Axes)
 * Energy of Strength (For Quantum Horizon)
 * Guardian Spark (For Sandalphon)
 * Star Fragment (For Arbalest)
 * Resonance Energy (For Gravity Repulsor)
 * Dragon Scales (For Naberius)
 * Radiance Fragment (For Brionac)
 * Ice Breath (For Frost Viper)
 * Epic Weapon upgrade blueprint (require either original or expanded variant owned permanently)

For resales of previous Epic weapons and their modified variants, the ways to obtain are:

 * Epic Decoder
 * Epic weapon Guaranteed Giveaway (by decoding 300 Epic decoders)
 * Key (CSO China only, for Gungnir and Dark Star)
 * New epic fragment events and their respective shops:
 * Energy of Strength (For Dread Nova and Blaze Nova)
 * Guardian Spark (For Gungnir and Dark Star)
 * Epic Weapon Craft

## Weapons

* Gungnir

Created with an unknown super-technology, this weapon was unearthed from a fallen meteorite found deep within the ocean. It stores and releases powerful waves of energy.

 * Dread Nova

A weapon used by Overseer High Inquisitor. Its astrology power used to defend the balance of the universe. <Nova Cannon>: Pressing RMB can charge up a powerful attack. <Summon Astral Lord>: When the lower gauge is 100, user can unleash the Astral Lord by entering LMB > RMB > RMB > LMB. Summon function does not work in non-zombie modes.

 * Heaven Splitter

This weapon fires special rounds said to be imbued with the energy of the fire dragons of legend. The rounds detonate on hit, inflicting substantial damage. It can be modified to dispense mines that inflict immense fire damage to the enemies, and which you yourself can use to quickly jump to safety.

 * Void Avenger

A special weapon used by the Overseers, created with otherworldly technology. It can automatically detect and lock onto enemies. Its Void Judgment utilizes charged dark energy to fire a singularity that draws in enemies.

 * Dark Star

A modified version of the Gungnir. It has been upgraded for increased destructive force, but at the cost of increased power consumption. Deals lightning damage to nearby enemies and has an energy-based fire mode for ranged battles.

 * Divine Blaster

A weapon of the heavens, created with celestial technology. Allows the wielder to fire 50 scatter-shot rounds, summon Purifying Wings to burn enemies who approach, and draw energy from the wings to blast foes with Purifying Light.

 * Blaze Nova

A weapon used by Overseer Executor. It uses the power of the blaze to conquer the universe.

 * Twin Shadow Axes

Powerful twin axes imbued with the strength of a mighty general. Allows the wielder to use a combo attack that connects the twin axes together. Grants two special skills that summon the general: Shadow Slam and Shadow Vortex.

 * Quantum Horizon

Sealed super tech that has been unearthed and weaponized with quantum technology. It has a basic attack that causes quantum explosions and the special features [Quantum Disruptor], that is capable of homing into and attacking multiple enemies, and [Quantum Dive], which teleports the wielder to safety in moments of fatal danger.

 * Supreme Sentinel

A special weapon used by the Overseers, created with otherworldly technology. It can automatically detect and lock onto enemies. Its Void Judgment utilizes charged dark energy to fire a singularity that draws in enemies. Customized for the Overseer High Inquisitor.

 * Sandalphon

A weapon from a different dimension, known as Heavenly Relic. When deployed, it can protect its wielder and summon a heavenly being. It use charged energy with those following functions: Guardian Spark, Light of Judgement, Furious Blow.

 * Asura Hell Splitter

This weapon fires special rounds said to be imbued with the energy of the ice dragons of legend. The rounds detonate on hit, inflicting substantial damage. It can be modified to dispense mines that use the power of explosions to inflict immense damage to enemies. The mine can be detonated by enemies, or you can manually detonate them yourself for a quick, theoretically harmless jump to safety.

 * Arbalest

A secret weapon created by Kronos with the Cosmic Stone stolen from the Aegis Institute. Its basic attack causes an intermittent explosion, the <Cosmic Wave> that attacks an entire area and causes an additional attack on the target area if sustained long enough, the <Cosmic Black Hole> that fires a black hole ahead to cause damage, and the <Cosmic Armor> that automatically protect against zombie attacks.

 * Doom Blaster

A demonic weapon, forged in the depths of hell. Allows the wielder to fire 60 scatter-shot rounds, summon Decimation Wings to burn enemies who approach, and draw energy from the wings to blast foes with Doomsday Strike.

 * Gravity Repulsor

A weapon created with anti-gravity technology. Fires anti-gravity rounds to inflict damage over an area and sends out pulses around the player to protect them. You can also automatically charge the anti-gravity energy to leap and hover in air, and rapidly descent and inflict damage.

 * Twin Light Axes

Powerful twin axes imbued with the strength of a mighty war lord. Allows the wielder to use a combo attack that connects the twin axes together. Grants two special skills that summon the war lord: Light Slam and Light Vortex.

 * Naberius

An underworld weapon that appears to be imbued with an aura of death. Your soul gauge increases based on the number of basic attacks you make, gain special rounds over time, and if you kill an enemy by using Naberius, you can harvest their soul to gain additional special rounds. You can use Soul Orb, which defends your perimeter or damage enemies with projectiles, or Soul Helix, which deals heavy damage to enemies ahead of you. In moments of crisis, you can use Soul Armor to automatically block and knock back zombie attacks.

 * Belial

A weapon from a corrupted dimension, known as a Demonic Ruins. When deployed, it can attack nearby enemies and summon a demonic being. It use charged energy with those following functions: Guardian Corruption, Darkness Judgement, Destructive Blow

 * Frost Viper

A weapon made with an unknown technology that controls the power of frost snakes. Basic attacks deal area damage to the enemy behind the enemy, and when attacking an enemy, <Frost Spike> can be activated with a probability to deal additional damage. You can use <Frost Sphere>, which deals damage to enemies by firing a projectile using special bullets acquired over time, <Frost Ray>, which deals powerful damage to enemies in front, and <Frost Shield>, which protects your surroundings, can also be activated. In a moment of crisis, you can use <Frost Armor>, which automatically defends against zombie attacks and pushes them back.

 * Abyss Repulsor

A weapon created with anti-gravity technology, modified by Kronos. Fires anti-gravity rounds to inflict damage over an area, and sends out pulses around the player to protect them. You can also automatically charge the anti-gravity energy to leap and hover in air, then rapidly descend to inflict damage.

 * Lycaon

A totem of unknown origin bound to the soul of a wolf. It appears to be an ancient shamanic relic. It can be used by switching between <Vanguard Mode>, which protects the owner by using the soul of the bound wolf, <Sentinel Mode>,which attacks nearby enemies from a fixed location, and <Phantom Rush>, which causes a pack of wolves to rush and attack nearby enemies.

 * Arcane Naberius

A weapon made with an unknown technique that seems to be imbued with the energy of death and soul. Depending on the number of basic attacks, you can obtain a soul gauge and special bullets over time, and if you participate in the death of an enemy using Arcane Naberius, you can harvest the target's soul and obtain additional special bullets.

 * Giga Break

A weapon that controls and releases infinite power. However, since it cannot be perfectly controlled, only a limited amount of power can be used. Consecutive basic attacks release energy. Swinging the weapon twice in succession creates an Overflow-Alpha state, allowing for a brief period of enhanced basic attacks. Using charged special bullets to create an Overflow-Beta state allows for extended periods of enhanced attacks. Additionally, a Wingman protects the user in Zombie Mode and Zombie Scenario Mode.

 * Luminious Brionac

This is a melee weapon where a sentient radiance seeks out and attacks enemies. Losing your mind to its brilliance leads to death. You can use [Luminous Gust], which burns the surroundings with light and releases gathered power; [Luminous Storm], which instantly creates a massive storm; and [Luminous Spear], which serves as a ranged attack.

 * Eclipse Shifter

A secondary weapon that condenses light energy to serve as its power source. It continuously absorbs light energy to generate projectiles and emits waves of light to attack nearby enemies while in use. Light energy can be used to leap into stealth mode or to summon a guardian spirit that follows the player to attack and push back enemies. Using light energy triggers Resonance, which restores ammo and reduces the light energy cost of the next special ability used within a certain timeframe.

## Trivia

* This series tells the further beyond of fantasy, interstellar, multiversal, myths and legends, sometime it connects directly to specific transcendent class.
 * These weapons are also known to have the ability of re-materialize in case of being used as detonation type. Notably Gungnir/Dark Star, Sandalphon.
 * The following origin of these weapons are:
 * Overseer: Gungnir, Dread Nova, Dark Star, Blaze Nova, Void Avenger, Supreme Sentinel.
 * Heavenly Principles (Mostly Kal-El): Divine Blaster, Sandalphon.
 * Unknown: Quantum Horizon, Gravity Repulsor, Twin Light Axes.
 * Hell: Doom Blaster
 * Chinese Myth and Legends: Heaven Splitter, Twin Shadow Axes, Asura Hell Splitter.
 * Kronos: Arbalest.
 * Underworld: Naberius
 * This weapon grade on primary slot replaced the Lunar New Year weapons starting from 2019.

Failnaught or Huntbow is a Transcendent grade assault rifle in Counter-Strike Online.

## Overview

* This item can be obtained from Transcendence Decoder.

Failnaught, which fires 250 holy arrows, automatically aims enemies within a certain range of the crosshairs when using the default firing mode. (Does not auto-aim if beyond the range.) Hitting the same enemy with the default firing mode stacks a mark, inflicting additional damage each time it stacks. Upon reaching 5 stacks, damage is transferred to nearby enemies and the stacks are reset. While charging up, the Hunter's Eye activates, allowing you to learn the location of enemies within a certain distance and attack through obstacles.
 * ''Details: While charging by holding down, the Hunter's Eye activates, allowing you to learn the location of enemies within a certain range. The charged shot penetrates through the enemy it hits and roots the target in place if it hits a zombie that is casting a skill. The charged shot pierces enemies and obstacles a certain amount of times, inflicts damage and a slight knockback. Penetrating through an obstacle triggers explosion damage.
 * Damage: 33 (Normal), 1350 (Zombie), 2050 (Scenario).
 * The effective range differs per game mode.
 * The default firing mode's auto-aim and stack effects, as well as the Hunter's Eye, will not be triggered in specific modes (Zombie/Human Scenario, Zombie Shelter, or Zombie Giant).''

description.en:
Falcon is a Unique grade sniper rifle in Counter-Strike Online.

## Overview

Firstly build in 1998, Falcon is a Czech single-shot sniper rifle fed with 1 round of .50 BMG. It has a very high destructive and penetration power, making it reliable even in a very long range.

### Advantages

* High damage
 * High accuracy
 * Instant kill to humans, except legs
 * High stun and knockback power

### Disadvantages

* Quite expensive
 * High recoil
 * Low reserved ammo
 * Heavy weight
 * Long reloading time
 * Single-shot mechanism (meaning it can be fired one at a time)
 * Obtainable through events only

## Release date

* China &  Japan : 28 October 2015.
 * South Korea: 5 November 2015.
 * Taiwan/Hong Kong: 10 November 2015.
 *  Indonesia: 30 November 2016.

## Procedures obtaining

SK/ID= This weapon can be obtained by participating in the Special Mission event: JP= This weapon can be obtained for permanent by achieving 30 minutes of gameplay for 10 days during event period. CN= This weapon can be obtained for permanent by logging in game at 20:00 (GMT+8) for 10 days during event period. TW/HK= This weapon can be obtained for permanent by logging in game during 19:00 ~ 23:00 (GMT+8) and achieve 30 minutes of gameplay/day for 10 days during event period.
 * Duration Extender can be used to increase the limited time of Falcon.
 * Obtainable by completing Special Missions (200-day duration for each time completing). Note that a Special Mission can only be completed once per day.
 * Permanent status can be obtained after collecting it for 1000 days.
 * Player can choose other prizes as well after completing Special Mission.
 * -|
 * -|
 * -|

## Tips

* Overall
 * Because of single-shot mechanism, it requires precise aiming to kill an enemy. If you miss, switch to a secondary.
 * Do not try the "quick-switch" trick, as it won't work. Every bullet needs to be reloaded only when the user wields the weapon.
 * The reload time is 3.5 seconds for every shot.
 * Try not to hit legs, because it won't insta-kill the enemy.

## Comparison to Hécate II

* Positive
 * Lighter (-3%)
 * Cheaper (-$400)

 * Neutral
 * Same damage (100)
 * Same accuracy (100%)
 * Same knockback and stun powers
 * Same ammo (.50 BMG)
 * Same reloading time (3.5s)
 * Obtainable through events only

 * Negative
 * Higher recoil (+10%)
 * Lower magazine size (-6)
 * Lower reserved ammo (-20)
 * Cannot perform quick switch skill

## Trivia

* This is the first Czech weapon to be included in Counter-Strike Online.
 * The full name of this gun is Falcon OP-99, fed with .50 BMG cartridge. There is another variant named as Falcon OP-96, which uses the Russian 12.7x108mm cartridge.
 * Its in-game name in the China region is "Falcon OP96", despite it being chambered in .50 BMG.

FAMAS F1 is a France assault rifle fed with 25 rounds of 5.56mm ammunition. Even though the damage is low, it has decent accuracy, low recoil, high rate of fire and light weight. It can be triggered to 3-round burst for suppressing the fire.

### Advantages

### Disadvantages

description.en:
The FAMAS F1 or Clarion 5.56 in game is an assault rifle exclusive to Counter-Terrorists in Counter-Strike series and Counter-Strike Online.

## Overview

The FAMAS F1 is a bullpup-style assault rifle which is fed with 25 rounds of 5.56mm NATO. It became the French Army's standard service rifle in the 1970s. This rifle is cheap, stable and accurate. It can be triggered to three-round burst fire mode.

 * After the Free Update patch, this weapon becomes a free default weapon in all player's inventories.

### Advantages

* Cheap ($2250)
 * Able to fire in three-round burst
 * Quite high rate of fire
 * High accuracy
 * Low recoil
 * Light weight (4%)
 * Free

### Disadvantages

* Lower magazine capacity than most assault rifles
 * Lower rate of fire in burst fire mode
 * Purchasable by Counter-Terrorists only
 * Low damage

## Tactics using FAMAS

* Normal matches
 * Use full-auto mode in close battle and burst-fire mode for medium and long range battle.
 * Always reload when you have free time as its magazine size is designed for 1 on 1 battle only.
 * Burst-fire mode serves lower recoil. This is good to score a headshot when an enemy pops his/her head out of nowhere in long range because its upward stray pattern.
 * Firing in full automatic while running makes this gun really inaccurate.
 * A little strafe or mouse control while firing in automatic will give a chance to score a headshot because its upward spray pattern.
 * In Deathmatch modes, firing in automatic is fully recommended since players keep respawning in different places.

 * Zombie Mods
 * In Zombie Mods, a 25 rounds FAMAS can deal 650 ~ 1300 damage to zombies. Regular Zombie is recommended as a target if you are using this rifle.
 * Switch to secondary weapon when facing a berserk Regular Zombie because it has low stun power.
 * If a player attempts a headshot with this rifle. It is recommended when encountering Deimos, Ganymede, Stamper and Heavy Zombie due to their big heads but keep an eye on the remaining bullets and the distance.

## Users

Counter-Terrorists:
 * France.png: Used by GIGN.

Zombie Giant:
 * Soldier

* More accurate (+13%)
 * Can be fired in 3-round burst

### Neutral

 * Same recoil (18%)
 * Same speed reduction (-4%)

### Negative

 * More expensive (+$250)

## Variants

This is a bullpup style assault rifle which holds 30 rounds for each round with 5.56mm. Its reliability and stability have been enhanced by improving the weakness of L85A1. Its second mode support a three-round burst.

 * Advantages
 * More accurate (+1%)
 * Larger clip size (+5)

Battle FAMAS=
 * Disadvantages
 * Heavier (-5% speed)
 * -|

This is a weapon which holds 25 rounds for each round with 5.56mm. It is recreated as a new weapon through an actual battle in fierce battlefield.

 * Advantages
 * Higher damage (+1)

 * Disadvantages
 * Higher recoil (+2%)

## Release date

* Battle

 * China: 24 July 2013
 * Taiwan/Hong Kong: 30 July 2013

## Trivia

* This weapon cannot be fired underwater.
 * "Clarion" means trumpet in French.
 * Unlike most bullpup weapons with a top charging handle, the FAMAS' charging handle does not reciprocate since its model and animations are taken from original Counter-Strike. The same also happens with its Battle variant.
 * When reloading, the ejected magazine is still slightly visible when the player looks down far enough. Note that the bullet texture in the magazine is drawn in 2D.
 * The model of FAMAS does not feature real-life grenade launcher sight and outer barrel groove for built-in proprietary grenade launcher. This refers to a Pre-Ban Semi-Automatic FAMAS F1 or known as 'Civilian FAMAS' in the U.S by removing aformentioned items and both Full-Automatic/3-Round Burst firing mode in order to fulfill non-automatic weapon regulation in the U.S.

description.en:
FG-Launcher (Firecracker Grenade Launcher) is Unique grade equipment primary weapon in Counter-Strike Online.

## Overview

FG-Launcher (Firecracker Grenade Launcher) is a grenade launcher modified from a firecracker fed with 10 rounds of 40×46mm grenade. If an enemy is near the blast radius of the launched grenade, they will experience a disorienting screen shake.

### Advantages

* High magazine size for a grenade launcher
 * Usable by both Counter-Terrorists and Terrorists
 * High reserve ammunition for a grenade launcher
 * Screen-shaking effect to disorient enemies
 * High damage to zombies

### Disadvantages

* Unobtainable for now
 * Long reload time
 * No optical zoom
 * Hurts user if nearby blast radius
 * No stun and knockback

## Tips

* Disturbs players' concentration, making their movement difficult as it screenshakes them, including the user him/herself.
 * Do note that the damage is very high that it might kill yourself.
 * In Zombie Infection modes, it can do significant damage to zombies with Gun Boost 6 and Critical 6/Power Up 6, noticeably in large hordes.
 * In Zombie Scenario, it deals high damage to bosses. However, the explosion might kill you if you use it as crowd clearer.

Firebomb, Flaming Hand Grenade, Incendiary Grenade or Napalm Bomb is a type of grenade that causes the target to burn in flames in Counter-Strike Online exclusive only to Zombie: The Mutation, Zombie: The Hero and Zombie: The Union.

## Overview

The firebomb is a modified version of the M67 Hand Grenade. When thrown, it explodes and sets any nearby zombies on fire. The fire deals 50 damage every second for 10 seconds, giving a total of 500 health damage. If the grenade explodes near the thrower, the thrower will also receive the flame effect. If the victim has 1 health point left, the flame can do no more damage. The flame will extinguish after 10 seconds.

 * After the Free Update patch, this grenade becomes a free default weapon in all player's inventories.

### Advantages

* Can be thrown further than the HE Grenade
 * Able to reveal an invisible light zombie
 * Has an afterburn effect
 * Free

### Disadvantages

* May inflict extra damage to the user
 * Only usable for a limited amount of time
 * Only usable in certain modes

## Tips

* Use it when a zombie is retreating, the damage done might kill the zombie.
 * Use it in ducts when you are at the front line. Do not throw it when you are at the middle line.
 * Always throw at a group of zombies for maximum performance.
 * When facing a host zombie in places such as ducts, use this grenade to weaken it before using your primary weapon.

## Trivia

* This grenade is actually a reskinned M67 Hand Grenade exclusively for Zombie Mode
 * This grenade can only be used in Zombie Mode, and cannot be used in the other way around

The Flashbang or Stun grenade is a kind of non-lethal hand grenade in Counter-Strike series and Counter-Strike Online.

## Overview

The Flashbang is a grenade that can blind enemies for several seconds. It is very useful in small rooms and enclosed areas. A player is able to carry two flashbangs at a time.

This equipment is also obtainable through supply boxes in Zombie: The Mutation and Zombie: The Hero. It is not available in some modes.

In Zombie Z, Flashbang functions has been changed to Nitrogen Grenade that can freeze zombies for a period of time during explosion. It is only obtainable when the user has Nitrogen Grenade ability.

 * After the Free Update patch of South Korea, this grenade becomes a free default weapon in all player's inventories.

The FN F2000 is a Belgium assault rifle fed with 30 rounds of 5.56 NATO. It is equipped with a usable low power scope for middle range engagement. Generally, it has a balanced power between damage and accuracy.

## Overview

The Mk 48 is a light machine gun chambered with 120 rounds of 7.62 NATO cartridges that deals more damage than its original model, the M249. It has stable accuracy, moderate recoil and has a usable scope. However, this machine gun has low rate of fire and takes longer time to reload.

* Very high damage for a machine gun
 * Stable accuracy
 * Moderate recoil
 * High clip size
 * Can zoom via scope
 * Light weight for a machine gun
 * Enhanceable
 * High stun to zombies

### Disadvantages

* Low rate of fire
 * Expensive bullet
 * Inaccurate at long range
 * Expensive
 * Long reload time
 * Low knockback power

## Tips

* 120 rounds of Mk 48, can deal 3960 ~ 7920 damage to zombies.
 * Due to low rate of fire, this weapon is not excellent in engaging Heavy zombie and 'Berserk' Regular zombie in ducts.

This feature has been removed in all regions

description.en:
FN P90 (Fabrique Nationale Project 1990) is a Belgium submachine gun in Counter-Strike series and Counter-Strike Online. It was added into the game since Counter-Strike BETA 3 in 14 September 1999. It is renamed to ES C90 in certain regions.

## Overview

FN P90 is a Belgian submachine gun fed with 50 rounds of 5.7×28mm. Even though its damage is low, it is countered with its low recoil, very high rate of fire and light body. Its large magazine capacity allows the user to encounter multiple targets at once.

 * After the Free Update, this weapon becomes a free default weapon in all player's inventories.

### Advantages

* Large magazine capacity
 * Accurate when fire in burst
 * Low recoil
 * Light weight
 * Very high rate of fire
 * Free

### Disadvantages

* Expensive for a submachine gun
 * Low ammunition reserve
 * Low damage
 * Inaccurate when fired continuously
 * Long reload time

## Tactics using P90

* Fire and aim for head in full-auto in close battle, chest for medium range and fire in burst for long range.
 * Reload only when there are less than 25 bullets in P90 magazine.
 * The recoil of this weapon is the same as MP5.
 * Target unarmored opponents if looking for a quick kill. This gun is not really effective with armored opponents.

## Variants

* P90 Lapin

It has 1% higher accuracy and lower recoil. The gun comes in pink and decorated with rabbit-themed accessories to celebrate the Year of the Rabbit.

 * Hunter Killer X-90

A special submachine gun based on the P90 manufactured by Kronos that is equipped with a Hunter Killer module, activating a tactical scanner after landing enough shots on-target. Thermal vision shows zombie locations through walls.

 * P90 Turtle Rabbit

The Space Turtle Rabbit is grafted onto the P90. It can use Rabbit Power and Recharge Power as special attacks.

## Users

* Counter-Terrorists
 * Uk.png: Used by Special Air Service.
 * France.png: Used by GIGN.
 * Germany.png: Used by GSG-9.
 * Singapore.png: Used by SAF Scout.
 * Soy: Used in Zombie File.

 * Terrorists
 * Erika: Seen in promotional posters.
 * Michaela: Seen in promotional posters.

 * South Korea: 27 January 2011

## Trivia

 * <Swamp>: If you right-click the mouse after charging 100% gauge, cancels the speed reduction effect on you, limits the attack/skill/movement of enemies in the area, deals damage and pushes them back Absorbs a portion of the damage as HP (Attack/Skill/Moveable Impossible, and HP absorption function does not activate in some modes.)

summary.en: The SPAS-12 (Sporting Purpose Automatic Shotgun 12 Gauge) is an Italian pump-action combat shotgun in Counter-Strike Online.

description.en:
The SPAS-12 (Sporting Purpose Automatic Shotgun 12 Gauge) is an Italian pump-action combat shotgun in Counter-Strike Online.

## Overview

This is a shotgun that has been used by both military and police which holds 8 rounds of 12 Gauge and manufactured in Italy for a special purpose. The dual-use technology version uses only a pump action mode.

### Advantages

* High damage
 * High rate of fire in semi-automatic mode (Deluxe & Superior)
 * Very high stun to zombies
 * Medium knockback power
 * Higher magazine size (Superior)
 * Light weight
 * Quick mode change (Superior)
 * Can be fired when reloading
 * Moderate reload time

### Disadvantages

* Cannot be fired under water
 * Low magazine size
 * Low rate of fire in pump-action mode (Deluxe & Superior)
 * Useless at long range
 * More expensive than its original version (Deluxe & Superior)

## Tips

* Treat this weapon as if it was the Benelli M3.
 * This weapon deals higher damage than the Benelli M3.
 * This weapon has lower recoil than Benelli M3.
 * This weapon has lower rate of fire than the Benelli M3.
 * SPAS-12 has the same weight as the Benelli M3.
 * 8 rounds of SPAS-12 can deal 656 ~ 1312 damage to zombies.

## Release date

* Default, Deluxe and Superior
 * South Korea: 24 November 2011
 * Taiwan/Hong Kong: 6 December 2011 (default & Deluxe), 21 February 2012 (Superior)
 * China: 7 December 2011

### Positive

* Higher firepower (+4)
 * Lower recoil (-2%)

### Neutral

* Same weight (-9% speed)
 * Same magazine size (8/32)

### Negative

* More expensive (+$400)
 * Lower rate of fire (-2%)

## Variants

Deluxe=

This is a shotgun used by both military and police which holds 8 rounds and manufactured in Italy with a special purpose. It uses both modes of semi-automatic and pump action. Superior=
 * -|

This is a shotgun used by both military and police which holds 9 rounds and manufactured in Italy with a special purpose. It uses both modes of semi-automatic and pump action. This is a custom version which improved the overall performance and reduced the time needed for mode conversion. It can also knock zombies away in the pump-action mode. Maverick=
 * -|

This is the modified version of SPAS-12 which holds 20 rounds of 12 Gauge. It was developed by an unknown Terrorist group and boasts a very high magazine size. Unlike its previous variants this one comes with two magazines attached which promotes faster reloading. VULCANUS-11=
 * -|

This is an automatic shotgun developed by Aegis Institute based on the SPAS-12 and fed with 8 rounds of 12 gauge. It is equipped with Vulcanus Parts System which delivers the currently loaded shells through an upright barrage upon use. Desert= This is the improved version to fight against zombies in harsh environments. It is lighter and has higher stun power. It can undergo up to 8 Weapon Enhancement and has Part System installed.
 * -|

## Trivia

* SPAS-12 appears in Half-Life, and the regular SPAS-12 and SPAS-12 Deluxe resembles Half-Life's SPAS-12 non-HD and HD model respectively.
 * Both SPAS-12 Deluxe and SPAS-12 Superior has DELUXE and COBRA stenciled on their pump handle.
 * The early name of SPAS-12 Superior was "SPAS-12 Cobra", but its name was changed later on. Despite this change, the COBRA remains on the pump handle.

Frost Viper is an Epic grade Equipment weapon in Counter-Strike Online.

## Overview

* This item can be obtained from Epic Decoder or Ice Breath.

A weapon created with arctic technology that imbues the power of the arctic serpent. Basic attacks deal area damage to the enemy on their backs, while attacking an enemy, marks [Frost Coil] by probability to deal additional damage. You can use [Frost Sphere], which deals damage to enemies by firing a projectile using special bullets acquired over time, [Frost Ray], which deals powerful damage to enemies in front, and [Frost Barrier], which protects your surroundings, can also be activated. In a moment of crisis, you can use [Frost Armor], which automatically defends against zombie attacks and pushes them back.

### Advantages

* Massive damage in all modes
 * Recovers energy if attack a tagged enemy (Frost Coil)
 * Simplified fire mode activation
 * Has an ability to fast draw
 * Frost Ray has long effective range
 * High knockback on Frost Barrier
 * Can switch to other weapons while Frost Barrier is active
 * Has aim assistance crosshair on basic fire

### Disadvantages

* Very vulnerable if not combining it with other auxiliary weapons or Frost Barrier isnt active
 * Frost Barrier can only protect player from 4 targets, has milisecond delay before next target
 * Overly relies on special functions which related to energy usage
 * Long energy charging time if not tagging any enemies
 * Frost Sphere has slow projectile speed

## Buffs

* Notify crosshair when successful hit
 * Unlimited spare ammunition in Zombie Scenario mode

## Special features

* Frost Sphere: Consumes 10% of special bullets to fire a frost orb forward. Deals damage to enemies hit and inflicts strong stiffness.
 * Frost Ray: Consumes 50% of special bullets to fire a powerful beam forward. Deals damage to enemies hit and inflicts strong stiffness. Frost Ray always leaves a frost spike.
 * Frost Coil: When attacking an enemy, there is a chance to leave a frost coil for 7 seconds. When attacking an enemy again, consumes the coil to deal additional damage and recovers certain amount of energy.
 * Frost Barrier: Activates when consuming special bullets, and if there is an enemy nearby, it activates once to deal area damage to the enemy location and pushes back zombies. Lasts for 5 seconds even if you change weapons.
 * Frost Armor: Zombie/Zombie Scenario It activates when you use Frost Viper for a certain period of time to hit an enemy in the mode. If you are hit with an attack that will kill you after activation, Frost Armor will block the attack, deal damage to the surrounding area, and push back the zombie. Reactivation is restricted for a certain period of time after activation.
 * Zombie Mode Activation Conditions: 80 seconds possession + 20 enemy hits
 * Zombie Scenario Mode Activation Conditions: 60 seconds possession + 20 enemy hits

## Release Date

* South Korea: January 16 2024
 * China, Taiwan, CSN: January 22 2024

## Comparison to Naberius

* Positive
 * Higher damage (+3 human, 432 zombie, 1803 scenario)
 * More stun power (+9%)

 * Neutral
 * Same recoil (6%)
 * Same speed reduction (2%)
 * Same reload time (2.0 seconds)

 * Negative
 * More expensive (+$50)
 * Less accurate (-2%)
 * Lower rate of fire (-4%)
 * Lower knockback (-2%)
 * Smaller clip size (-20)
 * Protection function doesnt recover HP by amount of damage taken

## Trivia

* This is the first Epic graded Lunar New Year weapon to have decorations that actually represents the Zodiac animals (the serpent).
 * The weapon mechanism are akin to Arbalest, Naberius and Brionac.
 * Upon the update in 1/22/2024, an aim assistance crosshair has been applied on its basic fire.
 * When drawing and reloading, the weapon white scale part darkens

summary.en: Gáe Bolg or Gáe Bulg is an Transcendent equipment in Counter-Strike Online.

description.en:
Gáe Bolg or Gáe Bulg is an Transcendent equipment in Counter-Strike Online.

## Overview

* This weapon is currently obtainable in Transcendent Decoder

This is a weapon for fighting against undeads. It knockbacks the enemy and explodes. After shooting, the spear can be exploded right away. It is used as a primary weapon. Knockback will be effective only in Zombie Mode or Zombie Scenario Mode.

### Advantages

* Harpoons are able to explode
 * Deals high damage to humans and zombies
 * Harpoons are able to drag enemies with ease
 * Very high penetration power (bodies not objects)
 * Good for destroying obstacles in Scenario modes
 * Able to kill multiple targets at once
 * Can trigger the harpoon's explosion
 * Harpoons can bypass teammate
 * Able to boost players

### Disadvantages

* Harpoon does not instantly hit the target
 * Expensive price
 * Obtainable only through special events
 * Low explosion radius
 * Explosion doesn't deal much damage unless direct hit
 * Single shot only
 * Very heavy
 * Easily runs dry

## Release date

* Taiwan/Hong Kong: 21 January 2014.
 * China: 22 January 2014.
 * South Korea: 28 January 2014.
 * Japan: 12 February 2014.
 * Indonesia: 14 July 2015.
 * CSN:Z: 17 August 2015.
 * Vietnam: 26 May 2016.

## Events

South Korea= The players must collect 4 letters:

Taiwan/Hong Kong= The players must collect 4 letters:
 * -|

China= The players must collect 4 letters:
 * -|

## Tips

* Overall
 * The user can inflict self-damage within the harpoon's explosion radius.
 * The harpoon can be set to explode manually by clicking alternate fire button (Default: Right Click Mouse Button) after the harpoon is launched. The damage dealt is also significantly higher.
 * You can avoid receiving fatal damage from falling off using the harpoon's explosion knockback; just before making contact with the ground, detonate the harpoon pre-maturely. The user would negate the fall damage, only losing a bit of health from the harpoon's explosion.
 * There's a trick whereby a player can perform a headshot no matter where the harpoon hits. To achieve it, the player must have previously shot the enemy with a secondary weapon in the head and then proceed to use the Gae Bolg.
 * You can access unreachable spots by taking advantage of its explosion knockback.
 * Before exploding, harpoons are able to drag anything that are caught by them.

 * Original
 * Harpoon's explosion deals only 10 damage to nearby enemies. However, it can do instant kill in direct hit.

 * Zombie Scenario
 * Harpoons explodes upon hitting bosses and mini-bosses.
 * Gáe Bolg's harpoon deals around 14000 ~ 21,000 damage to bosses on mostly any part of the body, as long as you have the firepower maxed out.
 * 30 rounds of the Gáe Bolg's harpoon deals 420,000 ~ 630,000 damage to bosses, provided that the firepower has been maxed.
 * Since it has a long reload time, try to avoid incoming zombies.

 * Zombie Infection
 * A harpoon of Gáe Bolg can deal around 1700 ~ 13000 damage towards a zombie while the explosion inflicts around  200 ~ 400 damage against a group of them.
 * The harpoons possess quite powerful push power that it can take out up to two zombies away with ease.
 * If friendly fire is allowed, you can use it to push your teammates away too. If there's no friendly fire allowed, harpoons simply passed through their bodies until it explodes or make contact with a surface.
 * Do not spam shot due to its low magazine capacity.

## Variants

* Stinger

A weapon designed to destroy the heart of a medieval vampire. Fires three stakes that each individually explode. Hyper Gaebolg

This is the modified version of Gae Bolg with some of the leaked initial technology applied. In zombie mode, the basic attack has a guidance function and a function to charge and inflict large damage has been added.

## Trivia

* The spear gun in real life is mostly used for underwater fishing or hunting.
 * "Gáe Bulg" was a name of a spear in Irish mythology which means "Spear of Death".
 * You can see a short cyan colored trail when a harpoon is fired which is similar to Drill Gun's.
 * The word "SPEARGUN" can be seen printed on the barrel.
 * The knockback power still has effect even though the round had ended in Zombie Modes.
 * The reload sequence does not match with the actual reload time. Furthermore, even though it is separated from the firing sequence, it is not necessary to switch to it in order to fire again.
 * After full enhancement, the magazine size is extended to 45 and there is an explosion hazard sticker printed an the top.

 * Cheap ($2000)

 * Light weight
 * Short reload time
 * Good accuracy in long range
 * Low recoil
 * Free

### Disadvantages

summary.en: Giga Break is an Epic grade Equipment released as the top prize for 2026 Lunar New Year Event in Counter-Strike Online.

description.en:
Giga Break is an Epic grade Equipment released as the top prize for 2026 Lunar New Year Event in Counter-Strike Online.

## Description

A weapon that releases infinite power under control. However, it cannot be perfectly controlled, so only a limited amount of power can be used. Consecutive basic attacks release energy. Swinging the weapon twice in succession creates Overflow-Alpha, allowing for a brief period of enhanced basic attacks. Using charged special ammunition to create Overflow-Beta allows for extended enhanced attacks. Additionally, in Zombie Mode and Zombie Scenario Mode, the user is protected by a Wingman.

### Advantage

* Massive damage on all modes
 * Overflow-Alpha can reactivate repeatly, result in a sustained large damage
 * Overflow-Beta allows 5 extra use of Overflow Crash mid-air jumps if switching weapons constantly
 * Overflow Burst has large explosion radius
 * Overflow Crash is very effective on close quarter
 * Overflow Crash grants continuous invincibility that also immune to explosion damage
 * Has Wingman that automatically detect and fires at 2 targets at a time
 * Basic fire has aim assistance crosshair and explosive damage for better hitting on targets
 * Second attack combo fires a small black hole that drags targets in (Only for Zombie Mode and Super Soldier Mode)

#### Disadvantage

* Very slow rate of fire on all modes
 * Take time to reactivate Overflow-Alpha
 * Vulnerable when either of the Overflow mode isnt active
 * Vulnerable if used Overflow Crash recklessly
 * No penetration power on Overflow Burst
 * Wingman deals low damage and stun power
 * Overflow Crash and Overflow Burst cannot deal headshot damage even with Deadly Shot
 * Overflow Crash cannot remove movement interruption debuff
 * Cannot cancel either of the Overflow state untill the timer runs out or the weapon is dropped and re-picked up.

## Buffs

* Crosshair notification upon successful hit.
 * Unlimited spare magazine in scenario mode.

## Special functions

* Overflow-Alpha: Swings the weapon twice in succession to attack the front and create an overflow state. In Alpha state, the duration is short.
 * Overflow-Beta: Creates an overflow state using a special bullet that is automatically charged. In Beta state, the duration is slightly longer.
 * Overflow Burst: Gathers the energy released in the overflow state into one place and strikes a distant enemy.
 * Overflow Crash: Converts the energy released in the overflow state into kinetic energy to move and crash.
 * Overflow Shield: Activates when you use Giga Break for a certain period of time in Zombie/Zombie Scenario Mode and strikes an enemy. After activation, if you receive a fatal attack, you will defend against the attack, deal damage to the surrounding area, and push back the zombie. Reactivation is restricted for a certain period of time after activation.
 * Zombie Mode Activation Conditions: 80 seconds possession + enemy 20 hits
 * Zombie Scenario Mode activation conditions: Possession for 60 seconds + 20 enemy hits.

## Release date

* South Korea: 5 February 2026.
 * CSN: 11 February 2026.

## Original acquisiton method

* The characters <기><가><코><어>, <행복해신년>, and the Red Horse New Year's Gift will be collected in bulk during the maintenance on 4/2 (Thu).
 * The <기><가><코><어> and <행복해신> collection missions can only be completed once.
 * When you obtain the <년> character from the Epic Decoder, you will also receive a '행복해신방마크 (2026)'.
 * Any unused '행복해신방마크 (2026) + 문<년>' items will be collected in bulk during the maintenance on 4/2 (Thu). Each unused item will be exchanged for a 한행복해신방마크 (2026) and Giga Break (Unlimited).
 * For the character <년> obtained using the '행복해신방마크 (2026) + 문<년>' items, each unused character <년> will be exchanged for a Giga Break (Unlimited) during the maintenance on 4/2 (Thu).
 * Participation is only available in rooms with two or more people. (Studio mode participation is available.)
 * Individual decoder probabilities can be checked on the website - [NEXON NOW] after maintenance on Thursday, February 5th.

## Medals

* Happy New Year Weapon Collection Event
 * Period: After maintenance on Thursday, February 5th ~ Before maintenance on Thursday, April 2nd
 * Details: Players who possess all 17 of the previous Happy New Year weapons will receive a special medal as a reward.

 * Happy New Year Medal Collection Event
 * Period: After maintenance on Thursday, February 5th ~ (Permanent)
 * Details: Special rewards will be given to players who possess all of the items listed below.

## Event

* Giga Break Synthesis Event
 * Period: After maintenance on February 5th (Thursday) ~ (Permanent)
 * Details: The first synthetic weapon in the new synthesis system! Giga Break is now available!

 * Only players with 2 or more Giga Breaks can participate in the Giga Break Synthesis Event.
 * When synthesizing, only one extra Giga Break will be consumed, converting it into a Giga Break LE.
 * Giga Break LE has no performance difference from the original Giga Break.
 * Giga Breaks and temporary weapons cannot be used as synthesis materials.

## Costumes

Glasses embodying the light of Giga Break, worn on the head.
 * Giga Vision Glass
 * Synthesis Recipe: 5 Glass Fragments (Obtainable from Epic Decoder at 6.090% chance)

A tail embodying the light of the Giga Break, worn around the waist.
 * Giga Mechanic Tail
 * Each stage item can only be purchased once per Nexon ID. (No gifting allowed)
 * To purchase stage 2 and 3 items, you must have purchased the previous stage item.
 * Unused Epic Decoder will be collected at the end of the promotion, and each Epic Decoder will be rewarded with 100 mileage.
 * Stage 3: 125 Epic Decoder (+25) + Giga Mechanic Tail If the item is not used, the costume may be collected.

## Variant

* Giga Break LE
 * Synthesis Recipe: If you possess duplicate Giga Breaks, you can use the extra Giga Break as a synthesis material to obtain Giga Break LE.
 * This item has a different appearance and is identical in performance to the original Giga Break.
 * This recipe can be converted to an LE version by consuming only one extra Giga Break.

### 5 February 2026

* Giga Break & Giga Break LE Balance Adjustment
 * Increased attack speed against wingman players and distant enemies.
 * Increased stiffness level against wingman players and short-range enemies.
 * Increased invincibility time of overflow crash.
 * Increased basic attack level in zombie scenarios.

 * Giga Break & Giga Break LE bug fixes
 * Fixed an issue where normal shooting would only consume 1 bullet when using the Zombie Scenario Extended Magazine add-on.
 * Fixed an issue where the Zombie Scenario Extended Magazine add-on attack would apply to Overflow Burst in Overflow-Alpha and Overflow-Beta states, not just the basic attack.
 * Extended Magazine Overflow - Keeps applied to overflow bursts that are mixed in during basic attacks, not in alpha or beta states.
 * Fixed an issue where when a black hole is created while holding down the right, inputting overflow-beta (left+right click) would consume 100 of the gauge and apply overflow-alpha.
 * Fixed an issue where overflow crashes could be triggered additionally even after the gauge was completely depleted in certain situations.
 * Fixed an issue where charging would not occur properly when switching to another weapon after activating Overflow-Beta.

 * Known Issues (To be Fixed)
 * Improved the issue where the overflow shield activation effect was not visible.
 * Store value changes applied according to balance adjustments.

### 12 February 2026

* Fixed obstacle detection based on the explosion range when attacking with Giga Break and Giga Break LE.
 * Changed Giga Break and Giga Break LE shop values.
 * Fixed an issue where the attack effects would display abnormally at close range when using Giga Break and Giga Break LE Overflow Burst while targeting a teammate near a wall.
 * Fixed an issue where the beam and explosion effects would appear above the actual hit location when using Giga Break and Giga Break LE Overflow.

## Trivia

* This weapon combines many features from the previous Epic weapons, especially the Divine Blaster and the Gravity Repulsor.
 * The design is similar to Gungnir and Spell Lance Scarlet Rose.
 * During its early development, the magazine catridge container is transparent, it has become solid on official release.
 * After March 5th 2026 update, the magazine catridge container become transparent again but only applies on LE variant
 * In addition, it used to have different energy catridge icon and only requires 20 energy catridge to activate Overflow-Beta, it has changed to charging percentage with require 100% charge on official release.

summary.en: Glock 18 or 9×19mm Sidearm is a Terrorist spawn pistol in Counter-Strike series and Counter-Strike Online.

description.en:
Glock 18 or 9×19mm Sidearm is a Terrorist spawn pistol in Counter-Strike series and Counter-Strike Online.

## Overview

Glock 18 is the spawn pistol to the Terrorist team. It is fed with 20 rounds of 9mm caliber and takes 2.0 seconds to reload. Overall, it has low firepower but it has no recoil even fired continuously and can be fired in three burst.

### Advantages

* High magazine size
 * No recoil
 * Does not affect player speed
 * High rate of fire
 * Short reload time
 * High stun power
 * Cheap for a pistol

### Disadvantages

* Low damage
 * Low accuracy
 * Low rate of fire in three-round burst mode
 * Low knockback against zombies

### Original

* Due to its low recoil, firing continuously will only affect a small change to its performance. However, when fired more than five bullets in a row, it is no longer accurate. Take cover for fire break.
 * Use semi-automatic mode in medium to long range battles.
 * Treat the three-round burst as a shotgun, use it for close range battles.
 * Although it has high magazine size (20), it is recommended for conserving its bullet because it needs minimum two hits to kill a full health enemy.
 * Its high rate of fire can be used as an advantage to kill an enemy with an instant.
 * Five shots on gut will kill an enemy.
 * A headshot is necessary for pistol rounds if starting budget is $800, even it does not kill the enemy instantly (100 HP without helmet). But it may help others to finish the target and/or push back the enemy.

### Zombie Mods

* Use Glock to run away from the zombies when the primary weapon has run dry, as it has high stun power and high magazine size but don't use it to hunt and kill the zombies.
 * Fire in 3-round burst and run as quick as possible.
 * This is highly recommended for escaping from zombie chase.

## Variants

Glock Red=

The Red Glock is produced in limited quantity and with additional damage. Battle Glock 18C=
 * -|

A battle-scarred Glock 18 obtainable from Letter Find event. Its secondary fire will activate full-auto firing mode instead of toggling burst-fire.
 * Advantages
 * Full-auto firing
 * While firing in full-auto:
 * More accurate (+26%)
 * Higher rate of fire (+6%)
 * While firing in semi-auto:
 * Higher damage (+1)
 * More accurate (+1%)

Oz Lion Pistol=
 * Disadvantages
 * Limited edition
 * When firing in full-auto:
 * Lower damage (-4)
 * Higher recoil (+22%)
 * -|

Based on the Cowardly Lion from the Wizard of Oz series. It can be fired in both semi-automatic and full-automatic modes. It also has an extended magazine (25 rounds). When equipped alongside other Wizard of Oz set: CROW-1=
 * 2 equipped weapons: the recoil and rate of fire will be enhanced.
 * 3 equipped weapons (whole set): the reload time and damage will be enhanced.
 * -|

A remodeled version of Glock 18 with a 50-round drum magazine. It can be reloaded quickly when hitting the button at the right time during reloading with its CROW Reload System. It can also be fired in automatic.

## Release date

Red= Battle=
 * South Korea: 31 May 2012
 * Taiwan/Hong Kong: 12 June 2012
 * China: 13 June 2012
 * -|

Oz Lion Pistol=
 * South Korea: 18 July 2013
 * China: 24 July 2013
 * Taiwan/Hong Kong: 30 July 2013
 * -|

 * South Korea: 4 December 2014.
 * Taiwan/Hong Kong: 16 December 2014.
 * China & Japan : 17 December 2014.
 * Indonesia: 29 April 2015.
 * CSN:Z: 28 October 2015.

## Users

Counter-Terrorists:
 * Uk.png: used by SAS.
 * Southkorea flag.gif: seen used by 707th Special Mission Battalion in some posters.
 * Usa flag.png: Oz Lion Pistol is seen used by SEAL Team 6 in some posters.
 * Gerard: As his personal sidearm.

Terrorists:
 * Phoenix Connexion
 * Guerrilla Warfare
 * David Black: Seen wielding Glock 18 Red in some posters.
 * Erika: Seen wielding in Manhwa.
 * Elite Crew: Seen wielding Oz Lion Pistol in some posters.

### Positive

* Lower recoil (-30%)
 * Higher magazine size (+8)
 * Can use three-round burst
 * Cheaper (-$100)
 * Higher rate of fire (+1%)
 * Shorter reload time (-0.5 second)

### Neutral

* Same knockback power
 * Same stun power
 * Same weight (0% speed reduction)
 * Can be used by both teams

### Negative

* Lower damage (-8)
 * Less accurate (-5%)
 * Cannot attach a silencer

## Trivia

* During the earlier stages of Counter-Strike, it had an additional drawing and reload animations as well as an idle animation.
 * These animations are only available until Counter-Strike 1.5 and removed in Counter-Strike 1.6.
 * This resulted in the reloading animation getting out of sync with the sound, meaning that the reloading sound will end before the reloading animation does.
 * There are some unused sequences in the Glock's model file, such as 'add_silencer' and 'holster'. However, playing these animations will show slowed-down shooting animations.
 * These sequences are actually remnants from Half-Life ' s Glock animations, again similarly unused.
 * The Glock in-game is modeled after the Glock 17 with an protruding barrel instead of a Glock 18, lacking the latter's selector switch
 * The real-life Glock 18 can be fired in fully-automatic and semi-automatic only, instead of 3-round burst.
 * The Battle Glock and the Oz Lion Pistol however has both semi-auto and full-auto modes, despite still lacking the selector switch.
 * Despite its proper model absence in-game, the Glock 18 did appear in selection icons for 707 and Gerrard.
 * The Oz Lion Pistol is based on the Cowardly Lion, a main fictional character from The Wonderful Wizard of Oz, a children's novel written by L. Frank Baum and illustrated by W. W. Denslow.
 * The words "COURAGE" can be seen printed on the Oz Lion Pistol's barrel.
